decisions.reason: Naval vessel lighting system involves high sunk investments and long-cycle marine sales, making temporary setbacks likely and escalation strong.
General interior luminaire has a generic profile with only passive website mention, reducing visible commitment and making it more vulnerable, though sunk costs still favor keeping.
Active public promotion as a latest release with microprismatic optics signals strong commitment and justification pressure, supporting persistence.
Marine searchlight remains in the visible marine portfolio and benefits from accumulated investment, though the earlier drop of the HMI version adds some risk.
